rows.note: Use 話 as the all-purpose spoken verb for conveying information or saying something, including 話畀人知 for informing someone.

example.english: I’ll tell you that we don’t have to work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use 講 when telling or recounting a story or other sustained account rather than simply passing on information.

example.english: They tell the story of that trip all night, until I get sleepy.
example.traditional: 佢成晚講嗰次旅行，講到我都眼瞓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 maan5 gong2 go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 gong2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 ngaan5 fan3

rows.note: Use 叫 when telling or ordering someone to do something, as in 叫佢走.

example.english: I tell him to go home immediately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 zik1 hak1 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use 睇得出 A when direct observation lets you tell that something is so or distinguish one thing from another.

example.english: You can tell that he is tired today.
example.jyutping: tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6
